title: Connecting Wixel directly to the phone usb for Dexcom G4
symptom: The user asks if it is possible to add data directly from Wixel to xDrip+ via USB connection, noting that when connecting Wixel to OTG USB port and using USB terminal, all data are available for Dexcom G4.
fix: The thread suggests using a program called dexterity to connect to the USB port and read the data, then telling xDrip to take the data from dexterity.
evidence_quote: It is possible using a program called dexterity. What you will need to do is to connect dexterity to the usb port and have it read the data. That done, you need to tell xDrip to take the data form dexterity.
